longTitle: An Act to consolidate and amend the provisions relating to offences and for matters connected therewith or incidental thereto.
description: Substantive penal code of India governing criminal liability, penalties, and definitions of offenses, replacing the Indian Penal Code (IPC 1860).

longTitle: An Act to consolidate and amend the law relating to Criminal Procedure.
description: Code of criminal procedure governing police investigation, arrest, bail, trials, and court jurisdiction, replacing the CrPC (1973).

longTitle: An Act to consolidate and to provide for general rules and principles of evidence for fair trial.
description: Law of evidence governing admissibility of electronic evidence, witness examination, and burden of proof, replacing the Indian Evidence Act (1872).

longTitle: The Constitution of the Sovereign Socialist Secular Democratic Republic of India.
description: The supreme legal document establishing the fundamental rights, directive principles, and organs of the Union and State governments.

longTitle: An Act to provide for protection of the interests of consumers and for the said purpose, to establish authorities for timely and effective administration and settlement of consumers' disputes and for matters connected therewith or incidental thereto.
ministry: Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution
description: Governs consumer rights, product liability, central consumer protection authority (CCPA), and three-tier dispute commissions.

longTitle: An Act to provide legal recognition for transactions carried out by means of electronic data interchange and other means of electronic communication, commonly referred to as 'electronic commerce'.
ministry: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
description: Regulates cyber offenses, electronic signatures, digital transactions, intermediaries, and computer security.

longTitle: An Act to provide for the processing of digital personal data in a manner that recognises both the right of individuals to protect their personal data and the need to process such personal data for lawful purposes.
ministry: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
description: Comprehensive statute establishing personal data privacy obligations for Data Fiduciaries and rights of Data Principals.

longTitle: An Act to consolidate and amend the law relating to companies.
description: Primary statute governing incorporation, management, corporate governance, CSR, mergers, and winding up of companies in India.

longTitle: An Act to define and amend certain parts of the law relating to contracts.
description: Foundation of commercial transactions governing offer, acceptance, consideration, void agreements, indemnity, guarantee, bailment, and agency.

longTitle: An Act to consolidate and amend the laws relating to the procedure of the Courts of Civil Judicature.
description: Procedural code for civil litigation, plaints, written statements, interim injunctions, execution of decrees, and appeals.

longTitle: An Act to consolidate and amend the law relating to motor vehicles.
ministry: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways
description: Regulates licensing of drivers, vehicle registration, road safety, traffic offenses, and Motor Accident Claims Tribunals (MACT).

longTitle: An Act to consolidate and amend the laws relating to reorganisation and insolvency resolution of corporate persons, partnership firms and individuals.
description: Time-bound framework for corporate insolvency resolution process (CIRP) and liquidation before the NCLT.

longTitle: An Act to consolidate and amend the law relating to domestic arbitration, international commercial arbitration and enforcement of foreign arbitral awards.
description: Model UNCITRAL-based statute regulating alternative dispute resolution, arbitral tribunals, interim relief, and arbitral award enforcement.

longTitle: An Act to prevent money-laundering and to provide for confiscation of property derived from, or involved in, money-laundering.
description: Statute penalizing money laundering, tracing proceed of crime, attachment of illicit assets, and ED special court proceedings.

longTitle: An Act to provide a general Penal Code for India (Repealed by Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023 with effect from 1 July 2024).
description: Former substantive penal code of India. Repealed and superseded by the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023 for all offenses committed on or after 1 July 2024.

longTitle: An Act to consolidate and amend the law relating to Criminal Procedure (Repealed by Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 with effect from 1 July 2024).
description: Former criminal procedure code. Repealed and superseded by the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 for all proceedings initiated under the new framework.

longTitle: An Act to consolidate, define and amend the law of Evidence (Repealed by Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam, 2023 with effect from 1 July 2024).
description: Former statutory law of evidence. Repealed and superseded by the Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam, 2023.
